My name is Queenasia Moore, I am a licensed massage therapist in NYS as of Oct 2022. I graduated from one of the top schools in New York City for massage therapy, the Swedish Institute. Additionally, I am also certified in sound bowl healing. I currently work in NYC providing medical massage therapy. I’ve had a passion for the massage therapy industry for over 10 years, being a migraine sufferer and always looking for a more holistic approach to my pain lead me to massage therapy.  The power of touch from massage therapy can help in more ways than one on more levels than you can imagine, mind, body and soul! 
This channel will be all about massage therapy techniques, sound bowl healing, meditation and just catching a vibe! 
Open to video requests & suggestions. 

Subscribe to keep up with all things massage & holistic! 

Follow me on Instagram @ZuriMassage
